purpose: Source/window implementation fixed after coverage and before probability scores
window: midnight to midnight local standard time throughout the year
source_gate: Actual per-market primary rules must name National Weather Service or NWS
candle_reason: All preregistered decisions fall on whole UTC hours; use bid/ask close at that boundary without any later candle
station_scope: Labels transcribed from actual January and July 2025 contracts. This file maps source-city standard-time windows only; it does not authorize weather-feature station joins.
historical_metadata_conflicts: Some January secondary text names ET despite a different numerical close_time. Enforce both source-period offsets and recorded open/close times; report disagreements rather than silently replacing either.
holdout: 2025-10-01 through 2025-12-31 remains sealed; no candle requests, label scoring, or fit access
